transcript: Speaker A: किचन से कपड़ा ले आओ। [Bring a cloth from the kitchen.] Speaker B: Bring a cloth from the kitchen. Speaker A: पहले तुम्हारा होमवर्क खत्म करो। [Finish your homework first.] Speaker B: Finish your homework first. Speaker A: तुमने इंग्लिश कहां से सीखी? [Where did you learn English?] Speaker B: Where did you learn English? Speaker A: मैंने इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से सीखा। [I learned it from the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: I learned it from the English Seekho app. Speaker A: इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप पे डेली यूज़ होने वाली इंग्लिश सिखाई जाती है। [The English Seekho app teaches everyday English.] Speaker B: The English Seekho app teaches everyday English. Speaker A: यहां से सीखोगे तो एक महीने में ही फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना सीख जाओगे। [If you learn from here, you will start speaking fluent English within a month.] Speaker B: If you learn from here, you will start speaking fluent English within a month. Speaker A: तो डेली यूज़ की इंग्लिश सीखने के लिए अभी इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [To learn daily use English, download the English Seekho app now.] Speaker B: To learn daily use English, download the English Seekho app now. Voiceover: इंस्टॉल नाउ पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on install now and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: Fluent English बोलना अभी सीख लो। [Learn to speak fluent English now.] english seekho. Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai...
summary: The ad features a dubbed conversation between two women on a stage practicing English translations of daily Hindi sentences. They promote the 'English Seekho' app as an easy way to learn fluent English within a month. The video ends with a call to action to download the app.
